priority: A: full-rank amplitude / absolute-unit-complex phase KRR pilot
reason: Nonzero-mode contraction, amplitude bias and relative-phase dispersion coexist; common-phase correction explains little. Test target representation without adding NP inputs or optimizer confounding.
baseline: reuse exact four n124 geometry-only KRR folds/models/P_scale; same train/heldout IDs, train-only input scaler, gamma/alpha and dtype; no search or baseline refit.
targets: 294 sqrt(A) coordinates and588 absolute cos/sin phase coordinates. Reconstruct A as square of predicted sqrt(A); normalize phase vector. All21 wavelengths,7orders,2channels retained; no full-state renormalization.
phase_rules: Zero truth A ->unit1. Training coordinate fraction<1e-4 ->unit1 target; record frequencies and threshold sensitivity. Predicted phase norm<=64eps -> corresponding training circular mean; exact-zero circular mean ->unit1. No heldout truth fallback.
scales: head-specific training means and shared RMS; unchanged kernel/ridge. Square and unit-vector maps are explicit candidate representation, never corrections to historical outputs.
fit_budget: 4 logical candidate fits =8 internal state-head multioutput KRR estimator fits/linear-system solves;0 baseline refits;0 new P_scale fits (reuse actually predicted frozen branches). Both fit conventions must be authorized explicitly in next task. Current execution=0.
output: 588 real reconstructed C_hat +21 independently predicted frozen P_scale =609. Same H2/H1; unchanged scale gate cannot improve.
evaluation: one fixed candidate, original four folds, paired geometry deltas median/q95/worst, phase/norm/tails, all original conjunctive gates. No oracle H1 or confirmation response. Repeatedly analyzed heldouts are developmental.
risk: Unit-phase projection may amplify wrong phase and worsen state. True-amplitude/pred-phase oracle already worsens KRR median to0.989. Full-rank structured prediction benefit is unproven; historical rank-2 polar POC cannot establish it.
backup: D: restricted geometry-local surrogate only after primary review; not parallel arm. Local curvature and missingD6minus/repeatability prevent claiming complete six-dimensional affine validity.
HF: 156G suffices for this developmental pilot without new HF. Independent confirmation and controlled repeated-run/numerical error evidence need separate future authority; no broad extra HF recommended from this audit alone.
